title: Silgan Dispensing lends its expertise to Guerlain's Longevity Concentrate
summary: Silgan Dispensing contributed to the design and development of the 30 ml refillable pump bottle created for Guerlain's new Longevity Concentrate in the Orchidée Impériale range. The foremost requirement was compatibility with a complex formula containing many active ingredients, partly derived from the Vanda coerulea orchid, and encapsulated in billions of liposomes.
